title: Invisible Decrease for Amigurumi
description: Shape stuffed crochet pieces with a decrease that blends into the surrounding stitches.

content.summary: Learn to decrease through the front loops so the stitch disappears more neatly than a standard decrease.
content.whyItMatters: Amigurumi projects look smoother when decreases stay tidy. This is one of the first techniques that makes toy projects look noticeably more polished.
steps: Insert the hook through the front loop of the next stitch, then through the front loop of the following stitch.
Yarn over and pull through both front loops together.
Yarn over again and pull through the remaining loops to finish the decrease.
Repeat slowly and keep the tension even so the fabric stays smooth around the shaping area.
content.practice: Work one small round of regular decreases and one round of invisible decreases on a practice swatch to compare the texture.
commonMistakes: Accidentally inserting through both loops and creating a bulkier decrease.
Skipping the next stitch after a decrease and losing count.
